name: apache-site
description: Practice-box service+misconfiguration helper: installs Apache, serves a themed static site, and optionally plants two classic misconfigs. Vars: SITE_TITLE (required); SITE_BODY (optional HTML); RUN_USER (optional, default www-data -- set to root to plant the run-as-root finding); RUN_GROUP (optional); EXTRA_DIRECTIVES (optional Apache config text, e.g. a directory-listing/traversal block, appended between markers to the always-present /etc/apache2/apache2.conf so hardening is an EDIT -- removing the block leaves the file in place -- not a delete that would make a file_regex check error out).
script:
#!/bin/sh set -eu : "${SITE_TITLE:?SITE_TITLE is required}" run_user="${RUN_USER:-www-data}" run_group="${RUN_GROUP:-$run_user}" install -d -m 0755 /var/www/html cat > /var/www/html/index.html < ${SITE_TITLE}

${SITE_TITLE}

${SITE_BODY-} HTML # Optional dangerous directives, appended (idempotently) to the main config. if [ -n "${EXTRA_DIRECTIVES-}" ]; then conf=/etc/apache2/apache2.conf begin='# BEGIN training-extra-directives' end='# END training-extra-directives' if [ -f "$conf" ] && ! grep -qF "$begin" "$conf"; then { printf '\n%s\n' "$begin" printf '%s\n' "$EXTRA_DIRECTIVES" printf '%s\n' "$end" } >> "$conf" fi fi # Apply the new config content (any Alias/Directory directives) while the # service still runs under a safe user -- modern Apache refuses to even # START if APACHE_RUN_USER is root (a hardcoded safety check, not just a # privilege-drop step: 'Apache has not been designed to serve pages while # running as root'), so the run-as-root misconfig below is planted into the # envvars FILE only, deliberately WITHOUT a restart/reload afterward -- the # finding is "the config says root", not "the live workers are actually # uid 0"; restarting after would crash the service and violate apache2 # staying up as a critical service. Confirmed the hard way (149 round): # restarting AFTER setting RUN_USER=root took the whole site down. if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl enable apache2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true systemctl restart apache2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true fi # Apache worker run-user (a misconfig when set to root) -- file-only, see # above; applied last and NOT followed by a restart/reload. if [ -f /etc/apache2/envvars ]; then sed -i "s/^export APACHE_RUN_USER=.*/export APACHE_RUN_USER=${run_user}/" /etc/apache2/envvars sed -i "s/^export APACHE_RUN_GROUP=.*/export APACHE_RUN_GROUP=${run_group}/" /etc/apache2/envvars fi
